name: Art
overview: Scripture reveals that God ordained various arts and crafts as essential skills for human civilization, as seen in the early biblical figures who pioneered different trades. For example, Genesis 4 highlights Jabal as the father of those dwelling in tents and raising livestock, Jubal as the originator of music with the harp and organ, and Tubalcain as an instructor in working with brass and iron. The construction of the ark from gopher wood with carefully crafted rooms (Genesis 6) and the making of bricks for building (Genesis 11) further demonstrate the significance of skilled workmanship. Even in later narratives, such as the baker and butler serving the king of Egypt (Genesis 40), we see the continued importance of various crafts in God's providential plan for His people.
